title: Best Workout Apps to Pair with Your NZ Gym Membership
meta_desc: Discover the best free and paid workout apps that complement NZ gym memberships, with real prices, contract details and a Les Mills On Demand guide.
intro: A solid gym membership only reaches its potential when you track, plan and vary your workouts. Pairing the right app can squeeze extra value from the dollars you already spend on a Kiwi gym.

sections.heading: Why Pair an App with Your Gym
sections.body: Apps give you on‑demand programming, progress tracking and community motivation that most brick‑and‑mortar clubs don’t provide in‑house. The data you collect can also help you stay accountable and make the most of your membership fees.

sections.heading: Free Apps That Work Well
list: Nike Training Club – over 500 workouts, no ads.
Adidas Training – sport‑specific plans, integrates with Apple Health.
FitOn – live classes from celebrity trainers, works offline.
JEFIT – strength‑training log with community leaderboards.

sections.heading: Paid Apps With NZ Gym Value

rows: All Les Mills classes, syncs with club schedules
AI‑generated strength plans based on equipment

sections.heading: Les Mills On Demand – The Official Partner
sections.body: Les Mills gyms across NZ (Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton and more) bundle a free 30‑day Les Mills On Demand trial into most contracts. After the trial, it’s $19.99 / month and you can stream every BodyPump, RPM, and BodyCombat class you’d find in‑studio.
